name: grok-subagent
description: Unofficial Windows-first Grok Build ACP integration with durable background jobs and a private ChatGPT tunnel adapter.

interface.shortDescription: Control local Grok Build background sessions.
interface.longDescription: Unofficial, experimental integration. Start, inspect, continue, interrupt and close local Grok ACP sessions. Includes conservative crash recovery and a private ChatGPT adapter requiring separate account configuration. Not an OS sandbox or a multi-user remote execution service.
defaultPrompt: Use Grok to investigate an authorized task.
Check the progress of my Grok jobs.
Interrupt my Grok task and send a correction.
